_doc: Which NVIDIA build model answers which work. Read by services/providers/nvidia.js on every call (cached, re-read when the file changes). Tiers are the owner's lineup; roles map the app's provider roles to a tier; tasks override a role for one call site and are written by scripts/model-lineup-eval.js from measured results. Each model entry is {model, effort}; effort is off|low|medium|high|max. Env overrides: NVIDIA_TIER_<TIER>, NVIDIA_ROLE_<ROLE>, NVIDIA_TASK_<TASK> as 'model@effort,model@effort' (or a tier name for roles). A task may set "only": true to use just its own models, with no tier or spill behind them (the NVIDIA_TASK_ env override ignores it). See curriculum-build/MODEL-LINEUP.md. 30 Oct 2026: z-ai/glm-5.3 removed (NVIDIA returns 410, end of life); GLM 5.3 Flash takes its place in the hard tier until a measured replacement.

pool._doc: The model pool (services/pool.js, curriculum-build/MODEL-LINEUP.md "The model pool"). The app's own chain (services/providers/index.js, in its preference order) supplies the slots NVIDIA / local / Gemini free / OpenRouter :free / Claude; the extra_slots below are further slots that exist only for PIPELINE-class work (scripts, the night runner, shared base levels): a request must say dataClass "pipeline" and carry no userId, or these slots never see it. A slot that is not in the app's chain serves a task only if tasks.<task>.allow lists it (glob on the slot id, "*" wildcard) and a slot matching tasks.<task>.deny never serves it. tasks.<task>.timeout_ms is the hard per-attempt timeout (default 120 s). Prices are USD per million tokens; 0 = free. Paid slots (price > 0) pull work only when the free slots cannot meet a deadline, and only inside their ledger (Standard Compute: data/standard-compute-ledger.json, $15 total; Munito: data/munito-ledger.json, $100 total, pipeline only, cheapest paid slot first so it goes ahead of Standard Compute; Anthropic: data/anthropic-ledger.json, $24 stop). OpenRouter is never a paid slot: only :free routes with a $0 price cap (services/providers/free-apis.js). LLM Gateway is not used for text. Gonka (data/gonka-ledger.json, $50) and Grokified (data/grokified-ledger.json, $135) slots, 4 Nov: Gonka DeepSeek / GLM go wherever Munito DeepSeek / GLM are allowed and sort ahead of them on price; Grokified grok-4.7 (a different family) serves only the judge/check tasks and the hard writing tasks, the dearest paid slot, last before the Anthropic key. Grok split (owner, 4 Nov): grok-4.3 (0.63/1.25) on the judge/check tasks, grok-4.7 (1.00/3.00) only on hard writing.
